text:
maria: seeing weird noise in the hourly GPU hours metric — big spikes every xx:00 UTC in eu-west for the last 48h. looks like a bunch of 1-2s sessions piling up.

raj: yep saw that earlier. ingestion shows lots of GPU_START events with no matching compute time.

alex: do we have any node/drain correlation? could be kube evictions or probe flaps.

sophie: I checked node-drain-alerts: small blips around those times, and network interface flaps in eu-west-2 reported by infra.

maria: current pipeline dedupe is only session_id-based. session_id is regenerated on reconnect -> fragmentation. propose new derived metric `active_slots_v2` that counts sessions with duration > 5s and dedups by gpu_id+minute window to remove these reconnect churns.

raj: rough SQL prototype: ```sql
SELECT window_start, gpu_id, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN duration_ms>5000 THEN session_id END) AS active_slots_v2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN duration_ms<=2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS short_reconnects
FROM sessions_raw
WHERE region = 'eu-west' AND event_time >= $__timeFrom
GROUP BY TUMBLING_WINDOW(event_time, INTERVAL '1' MINUTE), gpu_id;
```

alex: two caveats: (1) deduping by minute may hide real sub-minute multiplexing, (2) shared-gpu setups could still overcount. we should combine minute-dedupe with last_state per gpu_id (kv-store) to track active owner.

sophie: backfill plan: run a sliding-window aggregator over raw usage topic to produce active_slots_v2 topic. 48h backfill estimate ~2M messages, ~120 CPU-hrs. can run on spot workers with rate limit.

maria: dashboard changes: add `cluster.eu-west.active_slots_v2` panel, annotate with node-drain events and network-flap tags. alert if p99(active_slots_v2) > forecast + 10% for 3h.

oncall-bot: reprocessor job queued: reproc-1768500000, owner=raj, ETA ~37m.

raj: I'll own ksql/topology + PR. will add unit tests for reconnect->new-session logic.

sophie: can we tag raw events with `node_reboot=true` when syslog shows kernel reboot? aggregator should drop starts that follow node_reboot within 2m.

maria: good idea. I'll file a short runbook in the ticket for reproc and add the reboot heuristic. will also add a grafana annotation to show reproc window.

raj: quick note: if we change dedupe semantics, forecast training must use active_slots_v2 features. flagging Forecast team to avoid drift. @simon-forecast please watch for model drift after backfill.

maria: pinged Forecast team and added note to release notes. thanks everyone :thumbsup: :tada:
